previous_statement: Challenge disposition (blocking, not a proof of the parent). The objection is correct. In def-routef-raw-factor-setting, I_B denotes the identity map of B, so the unit element must instead be denoted e_B (or by an unsubscripted I forced by B-element type); thus v(I_B) in the parent is itself ill-typed. More fundamentally, the registered def-extended-delta-inclusion only says that every amplification is a delta-homomorphism and obeys two-sided norm bounds, while no permitted definition or external specifies any base delta-homomorphism clause. Consequently the needed estimate ||v(e_B)-I_A||<=delta cannot be inferred. This is not a merely omitted algebraic bridge: with eta=0, H=C, Phi=id, tilde-Phi=id, A=B=C, v=-id and u=-id, all explicitly stated linear, bijective, inverse, idempotence, extended-0-C*-algebra, and amplification norm conditions hold; because the base predicate is unconstrained by the registered inputs, it may be interpreted as true for these maps, yet ||v(1)-1||=2 while C_T*eta=0. Therefore node 1.2 and hence the unit proof cannot be validated until the pending request fac57c5a9b1c5586 is provisioned with an allowed byte-verbatim definition (or an allowed external) explicitly giving the unit-defect clause; after provisioning, the repaired branch must use e_B and the estimate delta=C_E*epsilon_AI(eta)<=bar C_E*C_A*eta=C_V*eta<=C_T*eta.
new_statement: Updated challenge disposition after provisioning. The earlier dependency objection no longer blocks node 1.2: the registered byte-verbatim external GT-kitaev-def-delta-homomorphism now explicitly defines a delta-homomorphism by the unit condition ||v(I)-I||<=delta and the multiplicative condition, and defines a delta-inclusion to be such a delta-homomorphism with two-sided norm bounds. Combined with def-extended-delta-inclusion at amplification n=1, formation therefore gives ||v(e_B)-I_A||<=delta for the correctly typed unit element e_B of B. The former eta=0 map v=-id is not a counterexample because it violates both the unit condition and, in general, the multiplicative condition for a 0-homomorphism. The valid notation correction remains: I_B denotes the identity map, so the amended parent uses e_B. Consequently delta=C_E*epsilon_AI(eta)<=bar C_E*C_A*eta=C_V*eta<=C_T*eta proves the repaired Delta-unit branch.
